messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — DataCorp wants to start a VPC/on-prem POC next week. They're asking to waive the one-time platform fee for the eval and upgrade support to Gold for the trial. Can Deal Desk approve a fee waiver + discount on year1? @Jordi can you confirm ops/SE needs?

Jordi Alvarez: We can support Gold for the POC but it requires 16h SE (env setup, SSO, KMS review) and dedicated node reservations for the POC window to meet latency SLOs. Ops needs 48h lead time to reserve nodes. Prep ETA = 3 business days.

Owen Patel: Legal quick note — if we waive the fee we need a conversion/recoup clause tied to a minimum committed license or the waived amount becomes non-refundable consideration. Also need to confirm DataCorp's InfoSec timeline for ATO/security questionnaire.

Maya Chen: They want a 6-week technical POC and procurement estimates final sign ~60-90 days after POC. They're cost-sensitive on upfront.

Priya Singh: Financials: one-time platform fee = $50k, standard annual license = $120k. A 30% year1 discount = $36k; combined with fee waiver that's ~86k hit in year1. Not ideal for us for a short POC.

Priya Singh: Counter-proposal: waive the one-time fee for the POC, offer a 20% first-year discount, and include a clause: if customer signs a >=$150k 12-month paid commitment within 90 days of POC end, we convert the waived fee into a credit applied to year1 invoice. Otherwise waived fee stays non-refundable. This reduces downside.

Maya Chen: Sales okay with 20% + conversion clause? I can present that to the customer.

Jordi Alvarez: Addendum: because Gold requires dedicated capacity, we need a brief SOW line for "Dedicated reservation for POC week — ops to be notified 2 business days prior" and the 16h SE in the SOW. I'll put a checklist in the SOW draft (SE hours, reservation owner, KMS tasks).

Maya Chen: Please add that. I'll send updated SOW and push for verbal sign-off today.

deal-desk-bot: Deal Desk Request DD-2026-089 submitted by @Maya Chen — request: waive platform fee for POC, 20% first-year discount, credit-on-commit >=$150k within 90 days clause, SE hours + dedicated nodes in SOW. Action: APPROVE / DENY / COUNTER.

Owen Patel: Contract language I approve: "If Customer executes a 12-month paid platform license >= $150,000 within 90 days of POC completion, Redwood will apply a credit equal to the waived one-time platform fee to Customer's first invoice. If not, the waived fee will be treated as non-refundable consideration for POC services"

Priya Singh: Finance sign-off conditions: 1) discount capped at 20% year1, 2) credit conversion requires >=$150k commit within 90 days, 3) final invoice schedule to be reviewed by Finance. Approve pending SOW with SE hours and ops cost center.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — I'll update SOW with the checklist and the contract clause, share link here for review, and request counter-signature from DataCorp.

Jordi Alvarez: SOW checklist I'll add: SE 16h, ops reservation owner + contact, KMS access checklist, target POC dates. Ops note: reserve nodes 48h prior.

deal-desk-bot: DD-2026-089 status: APPROVED (Priya Singh, Owen Patel). Terms recorded in Deal Desk.

Maya Chen: Great — moving to SOW -> signature. Will post SOW link in thread once updated. Thanks team :rocket:
